platform_scope: Windows CLI audit; conditional source comparison also records Linux/macOS readline branches

first_party_control_selection.rule: Static selections only, not newly executed or passing counts. Child stdout/stderr are decoded as text by check-cli.ps1; raw final conformance protocol remains separately required.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Unix-like shell note, _port early return, initial banner and working system command.
source_blocks.remaining: No test invokes _port; os.execute() and full source entry remain required.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Create three independent temporary paths through real os.tmpname calls.
source_blocks.remaining: Observed rooted Windows names cause denial; no API or return-value change is proposed here.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Recover actual executable from the negative arg indices and print it.
source_blocks.remaining: Negative-index control does not recover the whole original executable search or prove child identity.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Prepare text/binary files, read/remove output, exact or per-line comparisons, RUN success and NoRun failure/status/message checks.
source_blocks.remaining: Preserve actual os.execute, stdout/stderr streams, success/failure values and cleanup; direct first-party children do not stand in for original RUN/NoRun.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Two real -v children; redirect and parse actual release text.
source_blocks.remaining: Native banner control is related; original redirection currently fails and no release extraction completes.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Empty explicit stdin, multiline stdin via - --, and two piped echo statements.
source_blocks.remaining: No exact - -- control; Unix echo multiline and quotation behavior is a transport assumption.

source_blocks.public_expectations: BOM-only, BOM+source, BOM+shebang, and four malformed/truncated BOM failures.
source_blocks.remaining: Existing BOM+shebang and generic syntax tests do not exercise all seven original preambles.

source_blocks.public_expectations: After script dash, -h is a script argument rather than an option.
source_blocks.remaining: Missing exact dash+dash-prefixed-argument control; replace echo transport only after review.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Plain and versioned PATH/CPATH/INIT, INIT sees arg, @file executes twice, and INIT source-name error.
source_blocks.remaining: The 112 lack direct plain CPATH/versioned CPATH, INIT access to arg[1], exact source-name, and init-file repeat-state checks. Unix env syntax is separate from these public operations.

source_blocks.public_expectations: -E protects clean paths and INIT; empty environment subprocess; default paths reject xxx and contain lua.
source_blocks.remaining: Original lines 187-190 store new output in local out but compare earlier output. Preserve that weak assertion, do not claim it checks equality of empty-environment output. No -E CPATH control.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Release-gated bad-readline-library warning and -E suppression.
source_blocks.remaining: lua.c only loads dynamically with LUA_USE_DLOPEN and LUA_READLINELIB, outside linked LUA_USE_READLINE branch. Stock Windows flags select neither; applicability review remains pending, not a new universal warning requirement.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Six exact LUA_PATH separator cases use actual default path.
source_blocks.remaining: Only-separators and first-expansion controls overlap; ;, a;;b, ;;b, a;;, a;b;;c are not all exact inputs in112.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Multiple Lua libraries, repeated require caching, implicit and explicit globals, attached/separate -l and order.
source_blocks.remaining: Original line 240 interpolates a path into a Lua quoted string without %q; no escaping adaptation is approved. Repeated multi-library/cached outputs are not the same as the smaller first-party controls.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Actual lib2-v2 native module, suffix-stripped lib2 global and id() true.
source_blocks.remaining: Require_Library implements suffix removal but112 has no actual versioned native -l module case; .so is a platform fixture convention, not proof that a PE DLL can never have that extension.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Exact positive/negative index table, absent endpoints, empty attached -e, --, and matching script varargs.
source_blocks.remaining: Line260 interpolates progname into a Lua string without %q.112 does not check the entire original index layout or all absent endpoints.

source_blocks.public_expectations: arg exists inside required module before stdin script.
source_blocks.remaining: No direct library-side assert(arg) in112.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Changing arg[1] changes script varargs; replacing arg with non-table fails.
source_blocks.remaining: CLI passes Arguments_After into Sessions.Execute, which constructs string values; it does not run lua.c pushargs against the current global arg. No execution of this finding in this audit.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Removed print is reported through REPL error wrapper.
source_blocks.remaining: Authored print-removed input tests the same behavior; original echo and /dev/null still need native transport review.

source_blocks.public_expectations: debug.debug executes a command, cont exits, exact stderr prompts and output.
source_blocks.remaining: Library_Openers does not publish debug.debug; pinned ldblib.c db_debug owns a separate interactive loop, not product REPL.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Leading whitespace local warns; local1 assignment/expression does not warn and prints13.
source_blocks.remaining: 112 has a local warning as a side assertion, not both original lexical-boundary cases.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Warnings default off; -W controls/fragments produce exactly three messages without stray controls.
source_blocks.remaining: 112 covers order/default/enabling but not the complete original multipart warning sequence.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Two state-close finalizer errors produce warnings in reverse order.
source_blocks.remaining: No112 control for both finalizer failures and warning order.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Stopped collector; reverse state finalizers; newly created finalizer suppressed; collection unavailable; recursive close exit completes original finalizer order.
source_blocks.remaining: 112 proves ordinary state close, not this reentrant os.exit(true,true) finalization protocol.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Thirty script arguments reach varargs slot30.
source_blocks.remaining: Two-argument control does not cover original argument count or destination.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Attached snippets and separate snippet retain order and shared state.
source_blocks.remaining: Original combinations still require exact replay after transport review.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Empty prompts, expression-first parsing, multiline assignment and printed values.
source_blocks.remaining: CLI447 uses this original input content as authored fixture; it is not execution of original main.lua.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Long string across lines with empty prompts prints exact content.
source_blocks.remaining: 112 has multiline table/assignment, no exact long-string input.

source_blocks.public_expectations: EOF during a. continuation reports near <eof>.
source_blocks.remaining: Existing malformed statement and unresolved goto controls do not test this actual incomplete continuation EOF.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Prompt alo is resolved on each read, including EOF.
source_blocks.remaining: Process442 uses matching two input lines and exact output; original child remains unexecuted beyond early failure.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Default > prompt appears for two lines and EOF.
source_blocks.remaining: Existing REPL sequences exercise default prompts with different lines.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Table prompt __tostring grows X each read; exact three prompt pattern.
source_blocks.remaining: Dynamic prompt control uses equivalent authored fixture; no source authority inherited.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Table error __tostring sees real message-handler ancestry/currentline; missing handler reports error object is a table value.
source_blocks.remaining: CLI Report receives Failure_Image text, adds source/line and never runs lua.c msghandler __tostring/traceback phase. Fatal prompt raw reporting has a different contract.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Large multiline function, long/short strings, comments and multi-return expressions through REPL.
source_blocks.remaining: No112 exact broken-every-space input or entire return tuple.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Shebang with EOF and binary dump after shebang executes.
source_blocks.remaining: 112 tests text shebang, not EOF-only shebang or binary preamble; separate binary CLI tests are not among112.

source_blocks.public_expectations: An open default output stream is flushed and closed by process shutdown.
source_blocks.remaining: File lifetime/finalization is a real obligation even after temporary-path repair.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Version line followed immediately by hello has no spurious NUL.
source_blocks.remaining: Exact native banner and -i snippet controls do not assert this -v -e byte adjacency.

source_blocks.public_expectations: nil/0/true exit success and1/false failure, close requested each time.
source_blocks.remaining: Existing typed exit controls do not exercise all five original status forms.

source_blocks.public_expectations: os.exit(true,true) runs two actual lexical closers in reverse order with nil error.
source_blocks.remaining: One ordinary closer+finalizer is not both original lexical closers/error checks.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Remove program and library files; output file must already have been removed.
source_blocks.remaining: No orphan output files or indiscriminate cleanup may hide this original assertion.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Nine invalid option/syntax/script-name cases retain exact fragments and failure status.
source_blocks.remaining: 112 lacks -h, ---, -Ex, -vv, -iv, exact -e a syntax and -- -i script-name cases as a complete group.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Only actual T configuration: MEMLIMIT=100 rejects state creation with not enough memory.
source_blocks.remaining: No MEMLIMIT handling exists in inspected Ada CLI/session/adapter sources; test host Configure occurs after Session construction. Host conformance ceiling is a separate parent-owned change, not startup MEMLIMIT equivalence.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Actual T warning store captures all three concatenated fragment messages, then restores normal warnings.
source_blocks.remaining: No T-absent return or ordinary product CLI run can credit this body; adapter unit evidence is separate.

source_blocks.public_expectations: warn requires a string; failed partial warning leaves no unfinished warning state.
source_blocks.remaining: Retain both protected failure messages and absence of unfinished fragments in later warnings.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Print + and announce Ctrl C; no completion credit.
source_blocks.remaining: These markers cannot replace either actual interrupt assertion.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Real background child prints12 in protected loop; INT becomes catchable error; child prints42 and pipe close succeeds.
source_blocks.remaining: No production SIGINT bridge is present; kill -INT, & echo $!, /dev/null, PID/pipe status and process-group delivery all require reviewed native Windows counterpart, not force-kill.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Actual long pattern search prints15; repeated INT delivery stops native loop; pipe closes; at least two successful signals observed.
source_blocks.remaining: First signal installs hook and restores default in lua.c; long C search has no Lua safe point before second signal. Replacing search with Lua loop, count with fabricated output, or taskkill is not equivalent.

source_blocks.public_expectations: Final OK and zero-value main.lua return after both interrupt blocks and cleanup.
source_blocks.remaining: No original role reaches this marker in retained baseline;112 independent controls do not establish the final protocol.

priorities.proposal: Measure real os.tmpname results in private disposable CWD; retain all three actual calls and prove translated paths absent. Independently decide safe shell filename quoting AND Lua literal escaping (%q or equivalent source-reviewed span). Preserve actual executable and raw output, stdout/stderr and status checks. No transformed source or replacement helper is included.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Actual Windows default/T children open/read/remove only disposable paths, preserve backslash/space argv and executable identity, then independently review exact source spans; Verybig12-byte approval does not automatically cover main.

priorities.proposal: Split authored native subprocess controls into input-byte transport, per-child environment and null-device redirection. Use explicit argv/env/stdin for counterparts; any later original-source equivalent must preserve its real Lua os.execute/io.popen operations rather than delegate them away. Quote conventions require their own narrow review.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Default/T native prove exact intended argv/stdin/environment/result/cleanup first; no env -i stronger assertion is attributed to original lines 189-190.

priorities.proposal: First freeze native/Ada probes for mutated/replaced global arg, mixed actual Lua values, __len/raw indexing and selected script identity. Then design a private CLI/Sessions child operation using existing driver and traced actual values, not Lua shim or conversion to strings.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Actual native pushargs uses global arg, luaL_len, rawgeti1..n, and retains selected script name independent of arg[0]. Native behavior must determine callback/error/yield/refusal controls before implementation.

priorities.proposal: Measure ordinary string/nonstring handler behavior and exact public C ancestry for batch and REPL. Add a guarded host message-handler phase using existing iterative executor; retain original error identity, native tostring return rules, traceback and process/REPL prefix differences.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Native table error returns exact currentline-derived6 for original body; no-handler table fallback and REPL continuation recovery verified. Prompt fatal raw-report tests are kept separate.

priorities.proposal: Implement only after focused native debug.debug command/cont/error/stdio observations and an owned iterative continuation design. This is a standard library function, distinct from product REPL or T-only internals.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Real debug.debug commands use =(debug command), actual stderr prompts, caller resumes after cont, no extra Lua lexical scope or recursive executor.

priorities.proposal: Measure actual MEMLIMIT=100 constructor refusal in frozen native T. Design allocator fault selection before actual Ada state construction while preserving independently configured host hard ceiling and balanced failed construction; do not substitute post-creation T.alloccount.
priorities.positive_native_gate: T body actually executes, state creation genuinely refuses with selected provider evidence and canonical diagnostic; ordinary mode receives no T credit.

priorities.proposal: Add small source-linked first-party native/Ada cases for unmatched public assertions, in coherent loader/module/warning/lifecycle groups. Bind actual module image to current host (no reference runtime delegation). Continue to require actual main.lua review/replay rather than marking blocks covered from112.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Both configurations; actual files, finalizers, closers and streams; native module lib2-v2 entry and global naming; clean child ownership and no text normalization.

priorities.proposal: Independently review exact active preprocessing branch for Windows, Linux and linked-readline macOS. A native build without DLOPEN+READLINELIB cannot satisfy original positive warning merely because release is 5.5.1. Preserve dynamic platforms warning/fallback/-E obligations and fallback input/prompt behavior on Windows; no decision is installed.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Record actual compile flags/preprocessor definitions and run both positive/ignored-variable native controls in selected configurations. A version check or missing optional library alone is not evidence.

priorities.proposal: Separate true terminal detection evidence from line editing and signal integration. Use native Windows console/process-group delivery to the actual Lua child; verify first signal becomes catchable in protected Lua loop and later signal terminates native pattern search. Preserve PID/pipe/wait results, at-least-two signal observation and deadline/tree cleanup; no taskkill replacement.
priorities.positive_native_gate: Actual native Windows positive before source equivalence; distinguish signal acknowledgement from kill count/timing. True terminal input must be verified by actual native isatty behavior rather than treating all pipes or a pseudo-console wrapper as terminals.

retained_observation.outcome: All four original roles fail RUN67 at caller81 temporary output redirection; no later source block receives coverage.
retained_observation.limits: Do not import old image/runtime authority into this source inventory.

limitations: No native/Ada main.lua or new counterpart was executed by this task.
No current whole-file coverage, final return tuple, interrupt completion, module execution or immutable acceptance is established.
No whole-file _port return, _soft mode, skip, source deletion, stdout normalization, fake sourced delegation or eligibility installation is proposed.
Parent-owned allocator observer/host-ceiling files are dirty in Root and are not bound or changed here; MEMLIMIT startup requirement remains a separate test-host finding.
Each related112control is separate author-created input; relation never grants original-source coverage.
Historical passing112 counts belong to dated component evidence, not this audit.
